articles.title: Coinbase and OKX try to lure in Binance’s EU users after it failed to secure a MiCA license
articles.snippet: Brian Armstrong of Coinbase and Star Xu of OKX offered new users sign up bonuses of up to 8% of their deposits or transfers from other accounts.

articles.title: Binance founder CZ blames crypto's sour 2026 on mix of AI, global tension, 4-year cycle
articles.snippet: There is no single cause for the crypto market's 50% decline over the past year, the Binance founder told CoinDesk.

articles.title: Aave, Solana ecosystem tokens lead crypto rebound as bitcoin steadies near $60,000
articles.snippet: Tokenized stock trading fueled fresh momentum across the Solana ecosystem, while Aave founder hinted at token buybacks coming under new framework.

articles.title: Binance tells EU users it will no longer provide services after failing to secure MiCA license
articles.snippet: A day after withdrawing its MiCA license application in Greece and saying it is ‘not leaving Europe,’ Binance notified users across the European Union that it will suspend some services.

articles.title: Too big to fail: Strategy’s $13 billion bitcoin paper loss alone dwarfs hundreds of prominent tokens
articles.snippet: Strategy’s paper loss exceeds the market caps of hundreds of tokens, highlighting the extreme concentration of risk in the crypto market right now.
